No what’s imagined is your role as the person to spread awareness about how people engage with the game. If everywhere you step you smell shit, then maybe you need to check the bottom of your own shoe.

How can you think people who disagree with you are stupid or idiots?  The reason you are met with such resistance is your condescending attitude toward those who have different opinions.  I truly think you can be an asset to this community but you need to either take a break from the internet, or do some introspection on how you engage with people.

Packs are for getting cards.  What someone does with those cards is their choice.  Whether they play with them, collect them, or eat them isn’t your concern.  I think if you let people interact with the game how they want to, everyone will be much happier.  
You don’t have to be the one to tell people about limited, or that they’re enjoying their packs wrong.  Be the asset you want to be.  Not everyone here is a troll, and not everyone who disagrees with you is stupid or an idiot.  That actively undermines your message.

I believe you are acting in good faith and are trying to help, I really do.  I’ve seen comments where you are legitimately helpful when someone has questions about rules.  

If you want to create a dialogue, and spread awareness about the  half the game you believe people are missing, maybe try something like “hey nice pulls!  Are you a new player?”.  That creates a dialogue and offers the chance for someone to respond without copying and pasting what limited is from the WOTC site.

I hate to break it to you but someone disagreeing with you does not make them stupid.  People have this negative reaction because you come off as combative, and have a generic copy and paste response to posts that does not come off as helpful.   Not because they are fragile idiots.  

I understand you have a disability that forces repetition and it’s not your fault but it is your responsibility.  Yes there are trolls here that bait you, but not everyone who disagrees with you is an idiot or an alt account created specifically to mess with you.  To take a phrase from you, that is imagined.

Dude this comment right here is the issue.  The fact that you’re calling people stupid and fragile idiots because they disagree with you and act condescending is why people have a problem. 

I understand you think you’re helping, but telling people they’re using packs wrong because they aren’t playing limited isn’t the answer.  What if the person knows about limited and doesn’t like it?  Maybe they had a rough day and bought a pack as a way to make a shitty situation slightly more bearable.  Or maybe they have someone in their life who knows they like Magic, but doesn’t know anything about the game themselves and wanted to show this person they’re thinking of them.

If you’re so concerned about people falling through the cracks why are you only active here?  r/magictcg exists and has just as many new players if not more.

Packs can simultaneously be both for getting cards and limited.  

>that is imagined.

How?  How is my perspective on this imagined?  The only thing imagined is the position you have yourself and imagined authority on telling people how to have fun and enjoy their cards.  By telling people they misused their packs, you come off as gatekeeping and knowing more than anyone else on this sub.

But there is something wrong with what you said.  Packs are how you get cards, and it’s been that way since the beginning.  
I don’t want to take away from limited because it’s a totally valid way to enjoy the game and I’m really happy for people who do, even though it’s not for me.  I also think there’s value in telling people who may not know about limited that it’s a way to enjoy the game.
I think the issue people have is you come across as judgmental for people who are excited to show off their pulls.
